title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
why_read: A speculative, heavily conceptual paper about AI-augmented human cognition that reads more like a vision statement than a concrete technical contribution.
analysis: This paper proposes the idea of a 'cognitive symbiont,' an AI system that stays with a person continuously, tracks their context over years, and actively participates in their thinking and decisions. It frames this as a counterpart to autonomous agent research, focused on augmenting human intelligence rather than replacing human tasks entirely. The paper is largely conceptual, proposing a design framework and raising governance concerns like covert assistance during exams, rather than presenting any working system or empirical results. It may be of interest for HCI or AI-policy thinkers but offers little concrete technical substance for engineers.
